## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 31. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke opens optimistically: a return to the glory days of Oklahoma State football may not be that far away. He measures the fall first — hard to believe this was a top-10 team in 2021 and a 10-win team in 2023, given how badly the last two seasons went, with the Cowboys a combined 4-20 and 0-18 in the new-look Big 12, prompting the pink slip for longtime head coach Mike Gundy. He then introduces Morris, who played and coached under Mike Leach and Kliff Kingsbury and led North Texas to the programme's first AP ranking in over 65 years and a chance at being the G5 CFP representative. His conclusion is direct: the gunslinger mentality is back in Stillwater, and he thinks the Cowboys make a big leap, especially with an excellent DC in Skyler Cassity.
